minutes.headline: Sewer Commission voted to add Marshall Park to the sewer service area ahead of a special town meeting article.
minutes.summary: The commission backed the Parks Commission's request to include Marshall Park in the sewer service area, and agreed to survey Upland and Eastern Ave residents about a possible sewer extension. It also heard about the 7-Eleven condo site plan's sewer connection, manhole cover repairs, and the FY22 budget including a position change. Minutes were approved and the meeting adjourned.

votes.outcome: passed (voice vote, all in favor heard)

budget_items.what_was_said: Members said the budget looks good after a seven percent increase from Fitchburg and Leominster, with extra money held and flows to be monitored after the wet season.

budget_items.topic: Part-time position to 24-hour position with benefits
budget_items.what_was_said: A part-time position is expected to become a 24-hour-a-week position with full benefits at town meeting, adding to the FY22 budget.
The sewer department plans more manhole cover repairs and has bought covers; the maintenance budget is said to be fine.
Connection costs and betterment would be decided later and may be waived for a municipal connection.

decisions.decision: Barbara to send a letter to Upland and Eastern Ave residents to gauge interest in a sewer extension.
Rob to compile a list of other roads the commission might consider for sewer expansion.
Next meetings set for October 12 and October 26 at 6 p.m.

what_happened.line: The Sewer Commission voted to back the Parks request to add Marshall Park to the sewer district through a special town meeting article.
The commission voted to have a letter sent to Upland and Eastern Ave residents asking about interest in a sewer extension.
Connection costs and betterment for Marshall Park would be decided later and may be waived for a municipal connection.
Members said the FY22 sewer budget looks good; a part-time position is expected to become a 24-hour position with benefits at town meeting.
Next meetings were set for October 12 and October 26 at 6 p.m.

why_it_matters: Adding Marshall Park to the sewer service area needs town meeting approval, so residents will be asked to vote on it.
Homes on Upland and Eastern Ave may face a sewer extension, and the survey letter is the first step in finding out whether residents want it and what it could cost them.
The position change would add to the FY22 sewer budget, which is paid by sewer users rather than the general tax levy.
watch_next: The special town meeting article adding Marshall Park to the sewer service area.
Responses to the Upland and Eastern Ave letter, and the list of other roads the commission may consider.
